raw_segments.text: Elektra, handmaidens, orders of the palace halls, since at my side he come, a suppliant
train, companions of this offering, counsel me as best befits the time.
For I who pour upon the grave these streams funereal, with what fair word can I invoke
Shall I ever behold I bear these gifts from well-beloved wife unto her well-beloved lord,
when tease from her, my mother, that they come?
Of all words I fail wherewith to consecrate unto my sire these sacrificial honors on
Or shall I speak this word, as mortals use, give back, to those who send these coronals
full recompense, of ills for axe malign?
Or shall I pour this draught for earth to drink, sans word or reverence, as my sire
was slain, and homeward pass with unreverted eyes, casting the bowl away, as one who flings
the household cleanseings to the common road?
Be art and part, O friends, in this my doubt, even as ye are in that one common hate whereby
Fear ye not the wrath of any man, nor hide your word within your breast.
The day of death and doom awaits alike the freemen and the slave.
Speak then, if aught thou nosedy to aid us more.
